_comment: THE ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the owner's other projects.
Three things read this file: the Projects section on site/index.html, the
demo catalogue in site/static/demo-api.js, and scripts/seed-projects.py,
which writes them into the real links catalogue when a cluster is up.
url: null means NOT YET SUPPLIED. Every consumer skips those entries, and
the seeder names them rather than skipping in silence.
public DECIDES WHERE AN ENTRY IS ALLOWED TO APPEAR, and it is the field
public: true   goes everywhere -- the portfolio page, the demo
public: false  ONLY the real catalogue, which is the owner's private
Three of these four are reachable only by the owner: two are localhost and
one is behind a personal Xiaomi account. Those are entirely CORRECT links
for a personal start page -- pointing at your own dev server is what a
start page is for -- and entirely WRONG on a public portfolio page, where
every visitor gets a connection error and reads it as carelessness.
So the flag is not a quality judgement. It is the difference between 'a
link that works for me' and 'a link that works for anyone'.

projects.name: Procedo
projects.note: No URL supplied yet. Astro, so it can be deployed like log-book was.

projects.name: Notes
projects.note: Xiaomi Mi Cloud notes. Returns 200 to anyone, but it is the owner's personal account -- a visitor gets a login screen, not the notes.

projects.name: Acharya Amit
projects.note: Local dev server. Port 4322 rather than Astro's default 4321, which is what Procedo's README uses -- so the two can run side by side.

projects.name: app-hub
projects.note: gateway running locally. In-cluster the equivalent is the ALB from E-06, whose hostname changes on every rebuild and so cannot be written down here.
